plan.environment: the shelter dining hall exactly as rendered in this episode: grey institutional walls, one long wooden table running to a single far doorway, brown chairs on both sides, a blue-tiled counter on the right, tall windows on the left with warm afternoon light
plan.emotional_guidance: Valence: quiet, a little sad. Arousal: low and still.
plan.visual_style: finished full-colour 3D animation, identical in look, lighting and character design to the first frame; never a sketch

audio.sounds: P01 a soft rustle of the paper roll in Maria's arms; P02 faint crayon scratching from the children at the table; P03 the quiet air of the big hall
audio.room: a large hard-walled hall in soft afternoon air, everything distant and gentle

panels.video_beat: Maria sits very still hugging her rolled drawing; the boy beside her keeps drawing with his green crayon
the camera cranes up and arcs a quarter turn around the near end of the long table, Maria and the boy staying in their own seats on the window side

the camera settles high at the near end looking straight down the long table to the far doorway: Maria small in her seat with the roll in her lap, the boy beside her, the jersey boy and the braids girl across, MACA standing in the doorway

plan.continuity: Maria in the near seat on the window side of the long table with her rolled drawing; the crayon boy in the next seat up on her side; across the table the jersey boy in the near seat and the braids girl beyond him; MACA standing in the far doorway
preventions: one long table only, never a second table behind the children
no other children, no adults, no legs or shoes at the frame edges
Maria and the boy never swap sides or seats
Maria keeps the white roll in her arms or lap the whole time
